name: R5-D56
description: R5-D56, often referred to as R5, was an astromech droid that was the faithful companion of the former Sith known as the Ronin. He traveled with the Ronin through the edge of the Outer Rim Territories in the time following the Sith rebellion against the Jedi. During their travels, the droid was initially the only who knew Ronin's true identity and history, which R5-D56 did not disclose to anyone.

data.name: R5-D56
data.death: During the skirmish on Olcatz (later repaired)
